source.connector_status: GitHub MCP authentication succeeded but repository enumeration/content access returned insufficient scope

scoring.note: Scores rank near-term revenue evidence and strategic reuse, not code quality. Direct monthly cost remains null until invoices and runtime telemetry are mapped to repositories.

gaps.impact: Cannot assert full-company code coverage until GitHub MCP read scope is repaired.
RouteReady has an observed Supabase project/cost but no matching public source repository in the 87-repository inventory.
The $648 monthly software portfolio is known, but invoices/runtime usage are not yet attributable to individual repositories.
Traffic, customers, conversion, active users, contracts, and collected revenue are not exposed by repository metadata.

repositories.name: unique-staffing-prof
repositories.why: The staffing-specific workflow provides the clearest domain proof and a paid diagnostic can be delivered without deploying this code. Source inspection found a duplicate declaration that blocks compilation, no real test suite, incomplete operational controls, and unresolved customer/reuse rights, so the implementation must not be represented as production-ready.
repositories.next_action: Verify ownership and customer rights, repair and test in isolation with synthetic data, and sell only the bounded paid workflow diagnostic until production gates pass.
